$comment: Curated chain data. Read the honesty rules before adding entries: every item carries `source`, `verifiedAt`, and `confidence`. `confidence: "low"` means we have NOT verified this against a current published ingredient statement — most often it is the industry-default assumption that commercial fryers run a vegetable-oil blend. Low-confidence records can produce a `flagged` verdict but can never produce a `verified clean` one (see computeVerdict in lib/matcher.ts). Formulations change and vary by franchise; a chain with no items yields an honest "no data" verdict, which is the correct answer when we do not know.

sources.published-allergen-guide: Chain's own published allergen or ingredient statement.
sources.published-statement: Chain's own public statement or press release about a menu item or cooking oil.
sources.industry-default: UNVERIFIED assumption that commercial deep-frying uses a vegetable/seed oil blend. Always confidence: low.
sources.menu-listing: Item is listed on the chain's public menu; the named branded component is the flagged term.

items.name: World Famous Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, vegetable oil blend (canola oil, corn oil, soybean oil, hydrogenated soybean oil), natural beef flavor, dextrose, sodium acid pyrophosphate, salt.
items.note: US formulation. Fries are cooked in the same oil as other fried items.

items.name: Chicken McNuggets
items.ingredientsText: Chicken, water, vegetable oil (canola, corn, soybean), bleached wheat flour, modified food starch, salt.

items.name: Chick-fil-A Chicken Sandwich
items.ingredientsText: Chicken breast, seasoning, milk, egg, flour, pressure-cooked in fully refined peanut oil.
items.note: Chick-fil-A has long stated it fries in fully refined peanut oil. Peanut oil is not in the seed-oil taxonomy, so this is one of the few genuinely clean fried items — but sauces and dressings are separate and often are not.

items.name: Waffle Potato Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, fully refined peanut oil, sea salt.

items.name: Five Guys Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, peanut oil, salt.
items.note: Five Guys states it cooks exclusively in peanut oil.

items.name: French Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, sunflower oil.
items.note: In-N-Out has stated it fries in sunflower oil. Sunflower oil is in the seed-oil taxonomy.

items.name: Impossible Whopper
items.ingredientsText: Impossible burger patty (water, soy protein concentrate, coconut oil, sunflower oil, natural flavors, soy leghemoglobin, methylcellulose), sesame seed bun, tomato, lettuce, mayonnaise, pickles, onion.
items.note: Cooked on the same broiler as beef unless a customer requests otherwise.

items.name: French Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, vegetable oil blend, modified potato starch, rice flour, salt.
items.note: UNVERIFIED. Assumed vegetable-oil blend, standard for commercial fryers. Confirm with the location.

items.name: Natural-Cut Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, vegetable oil, salt.
items.note: UNVERIFIED assumption of a vegetable-oil fryer blend.

items.name: Nacho Fries
items.ingredientsText: Potatoes, vegetable oil, seasoning.
items.note: UNVERIFIED assumption of a vegetable-oil fryer blend.

items.name: Refried Beans
items.ingredientsText: Pinto beans, soybean oil, salt, spices.

items.name: Original Recipe Chicken
items.ingredientsText: Chicken, wheat flour, salt, spices, monosodium glutamate, fried in vegetable oil.
items.note: UNVERIFIED assumption of a vegetable-oil fryer blend.

items.name: Chips
items.ingredientsText: Corn masa flour, water, rice bran oil, lime juice, salt.
items.note: Chipotle has published rice bran oil for chips and sunflower oil elsewhere. Both are in the seed-oil taxonomy.

items.name: Steak Bowl (no chips)
items.ingredientsText: Steak (beef, salt, black pepper), cilantro-lime rice, black beans, fajita vegetables, tomato salsa. Cooked in rice bran oil.

items.name: Glazed Donut
items.ingredientsText: Enriched wheat flour, sugar, palm oil, soybean oil, water, yeast, salt.
items.note: UNVERIFIED. Commercial donut frying shortening commonly contains soybean or palm oil.

items.name: Orange Chicken
